stem: As a behavioural strategy, stimulus control involves which action?

options.text: Modifying environmental influences, such as not eating in front of the television
Keeping a detailed food diary to track every calorie consumed
Setting a goal to walk 10,000 steps every day
Prescribing medication to suppress the urge to eat
Rewarding yourself only after weighing in each week

explanation: Stimulus control means modifying the environment to reduce cues that trigger unhealthy eating behaviours.

optionExplanations.A: Correct because stimulus control focuses on changing environmental cues that prompt unhealthy behaviours, such as avoiding eating in front of the television.
optionExplanations.B: Incorrect because this is self-monitoring, which involves recording intake rather than changing environmental triggers.
optionExplanations.C: Incorrect because this is goal setting, not stimulus control.
optionExplanations.D: Incorrect because this is pharmacotherapy, which targets biology rather than environmental cues.
optionExplanations.E: Incorrect because this describes a reinforcement strategy rather than stimulus control.

source.hint: Think about changes made to the surroundings to prevent unhealthy habits.
